text:
Hiro: Noticed a cluster of costs (~$4.2k) billed to `shared-reservations` for jobs tagged to CustomerX POC. Looks like reservation credits were consumed by the wrong billing pool. Can infra confirm?
Dana: Checking. Early signals show reservation affinity rules didn't apply because the VMs were launched with legacy label `team:infra` instead of `customer:customerx`. There was a small migration last week.
Marco: If credits were used, net customer charge might be $0 but our internal cost pools are wrong. We need to decide: do we reassign internal ledger or re-invoice customer? Recommendation: reassign internal ledger, avoid touching customer invoice unless customer was under pay-as-you-go.
Olga: CustomerX POC on record: they expected charges will be reimbursed by Sales if over the $5k cushion. They likely won't expect new invoice. Finance: what artifact do you need to reassign?
billing-bot: ReservationAlert: reservations-applied-to-incorrect-pool detected on 2026-06-12. Case REF-7712.
Hiro: Provide per-line export + reservation id mapping. Also need the pool assignment at time of usage.
Dana: I'll export lines and reservation allocation table by EOD. Quick query: SELECT usage_id, cost, reservation_id, labels FROM `billing.lines_*` WHERE reservation_id IS NOT NULL AND labels.customer = 'customerx' AND usage_start_time BETWEEN '2026-06-08' AND '2026-06-14'
Marco: Once we have CSV, Accounting can run an internal journal: debit shared-reservations, credit sales-promo (or customerx cost center) for $4,200. I'll draft the journal template.
Olga: Sales ops approves internal reassign (no customer-facing invoice change). Please include a note that we resolved reservation affinity bug to prevent recurrence.
Hiro: Action items: Dana -> export CSV + reservation mapping; Marco -> prepare journal template; Olga -> confirm with Sales (done); Hiro -> track infra fix.
Dana: Uploading CSV to /shared/finance/customerx_reservation_fix/ now.
Hiro: Thanks team, let's close once journal is posted and infra PR merges to enforce reservation labels.
